customer: I bought my midsize SUV from Northwind a while back and I still haven't seen the title. I run a small business here in North Carolina and need my paperwork in order, so why is this taking so long? Who actually has it?
agent: I understand the frustration, and I'm glad to clear this up. Per our article "When will I get my title? (outside lender)," when a vehicle is financed through your own bank or credit union, we send the title paperwork to your lender rather than to you. Your lender holds the title until the loan is paid off, then releases the lien and sends the title to you. Northwind no longer has the title, so your lender is the best one to ask about timing.
